text.en:
Children and Young Persons Act
(Chapter 38)
Place of Detention
It is hereby notified for general information that, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 55 of the Children and Young Persons Act, the Minister for Community Development, Youth and Sports has appointed the Singapore Girls’ Home, 1 Defu Avenue 1, Singapore 359540, to be a place of detention for the purposes of the Act, with effect from 1st April 2006.
